Problem Statement
Read the radius of a circle and compute its area using a #define constant for PI.
Description
Define PI as a symbolic constant using #define with the value 3.14. Read the radius as a float. Compute the area using the formula PI * radius * radius and print the result rounded to two decimal places.
Input Description
The radius of the circle (a float).
Output Description
Print the area of the circle, rounded to two decimal places.
